There are three usual reasons your document stayed the same after running /relai-humanize.

First, the command never saves on its own. It shows your original text next to the proposed version, and it writes the file only after you answer "yes." If you closed the session, answered something else or didn't reply, nothing was saved.

Second, the fact guard compares the proposal with your original. If it finds any difference in facts, such as a changed number, name or claim, it rejects the rewrite and leaves the file unchanged.

Third, protected elements like tables, headings and code blocks are never rewritten. If your document is mostly made of these, there may have been little or nothing left to change.

Try running it again and answer "yes" when asked.
